title: How Quayside Staffing hires offshore staff in Cebu
description: How Quayside Staffing finds, interviews and places dedicated support agents, bookkeepers and virtual assistants in Cebu, and what each client approves.

data.title: How we hire
data.lead: Quayside Staffing hires dedicated staff in one Cebu office. Every client interviews and approves each hire before they start.

columns.title: Quayside Staffing
items: Writes the role with the client
Gives each client one account manager

blocks.title: Agree the role
paragraphs: The account manager writes the role with you: the tasks, the hours and the tools. See our [pricing](pricing.html) for how a role is costed.

blocks.title: Interview and approve
paragraphs: We shortlist candidates from Cebu. You interview them and **you approve every hire** before the start date.

blocks.title: Report every month
bullets: One account manager for each client
A monthly report on the work and the team

data.title: Talk to Quayside about a role
data.text: Tell us what the role covers and we will explain how hiring in Cebu would work for your business.
